AuthenticationResult.title: AuthenticationResult
AuthenticationResult.description: Typed verification outcome for one credential assertion: verified or failed, with typed reasons (at least one on failure).

IdentityRecordVersion.title: IdentityRecordVersion
IdentityRecordVersion.description: Version discriminator carried by every serialized identity document (currently 1).

MessageId.title: MessageId
MessageId.description: Opaque message identifier, unique within the emitting scope.

PrincipalId.title: PrincipalId
PrincipalId.description: Opaque principal identity: "principal:" followed by a lowercase slug; the single source of principal identity.

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (exactly three fractional digits, Z suffix).

AuthenticationReason.title: AuthenticationReason
AuthenticationReason.description: Typed authentication reason: a closed code plus optional bounded auditable detail.

AuthenticationReasonCode.title: AuthenticationReasonCode
AuthenticationReasonCode.description: Typed authentication reason: credential-verified, credential-invalid, credential-expired, principal-unknown, or principal-inactive.
